cards.name: Prism of Motion
cards.rulesText: Gain 15% Haste. Haste accelerates autos, casts, and global recovery.

cards.name: Dawn Chalice
cards.rulesText: Your damaging and healing abilities gain 3 power.

cards.name: Traveler's Compass
cards.rulesText: Your movement abilities recover 1 second faster.

cards.name: Oath of Protection
cards.rulesText: Redirected damage generates 50% additional Ultimate charge.

cards.name: Arcane Momentum
cards.rulesText: A successful interrupt makes your next cast 25% faster.

cards.name: Second Wind
cards.rulesText: Once per encounter, falling to 30 HP or less heals you for 15.

cards.name: Shared Burden
cards.rulesText: Healing a protected ally also heals its Tank for 25% of the restored health.
